asks.message: POSTTRAN reads the day's transaction feed AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYTRAN.PS but no scanned job, scheduler table or CICS program writes it: the producer of the posting cycle's main input is outside the estate
asks.request: Customer: name the system/job/file transfer that delivers DALYTRAN.PS each day, its arrival time and what happens when it is late or empty

notes.text: Every update job in the table is bracketed by CLOSEFIL / OPENFIL, which close and reopen the CICS files (TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, ...) in region CICSAWSA: online and batch never update the VSAM masters at the same time; a target design must keep or replace that serialisation.
POSTTRAN (CBTRN02C) is the cycle's business core: it validates each daily transaction (reject codes 100-103), writes TRANSACT, rewrites ACCTDAT and updates TCATBALF, which INTCALC later reads.

CBACT04C fee computation (1400-COMPUTE-FEES) is an unimplemented stub, so only interest is charged.
